title: Verifier-driven proof bootstrapping and length generalisation (June sprint 1)
model: 4-layer GPT fixed vs random-offset line indices; depth sweep 1-16 layers; cap-4/6/8 sweep
protocol: 1,200 RL targets 32 samples/round T1.0, 5 EI rounds, retrain from scratch; transfer500 pass@1/8/64 (T0.8/T1.0); textbook36 pass@16; second-seed re-runs of both chains; Part II single seed
checker: other:nd_sprint verify.py (pre-strict; r1-cot review found it accepts forward subproof refs)
headline: 5 EI rounds discover 418/1200 (fixed) and 747/1200 (offset) targets vs 359-364 and 607 for frozen resampling, but never-sampled transfer pass@64 moves only 0.310->0.356 (fixed) and 0.448->0.458 (offset); textbook peaks 15/36 and does not improve durably; offset indices remove a literal N9 token wall

title: Proof novelty vs difficulty and novelty-seeded self-training (June sprint 2)
model: 3.3M ND prover; frontier LLMs (GPT/Claude/Grok) 40-shot
train_set: June sprint generator data; flat zero-nesting 200k/450k
protocol: 3,000-theorem lemma-value analysis; 135-target 40-shot ladder; hindsight-EI on 983 high vs 983 low lemma-value targets, 2 seeds, transfer n=500
headline: lemma-value ~orthogonal to min length (Spearman 0.008); high-lemma-value seeding gives +5.4/+4.6 pp transfer (2 seeds) and 60-70% more harvestable prefixes; flat training still caps at 12 lines

title: First-order ND and eigenvariable conditions (June sprint 3)
model: bounded FOL ND model
train_set: synthetic FOL proofs (constants {a,b} vs full inventory)
protocol: pass@8 on relabeled / eigenvariable targets; single seed
headline: constant-vocabulary token wall: 95.3% pass@8 in-vocab vs 13.0% on {d,e} relabelings, removed by full-inventory training (95.5% vs 96.0%); eigenvariable targets ~94% vs 96%

title: R1-style symbolic CoT vs direct proof RL (pair 1)
model: pair1_8m_direct / pair1_8m_cot from inherited expanded-vocab parent
train_set: guarded cap-6 pool, 3,000 SFT updates + 256 RL updates (8 prompts x 8)
protocol: textbook58-dev 16 samples T0.8 + greedy; 1,536-token cap; one training seed per arm
headline: direct RL 11/58 vs CoT RL 10/58 at k=16 (each +1 over SFT); 0/43 dev targets with reference >6 lines solved by any endpoint; CoT spends ~2x generated tokens

title: FLoP-style backward-start curriculum for ND (symbolic policy and token LM)
model: symbolic legal-action policies; token-generating ND LM
train_set: 2 six-line demonstrations (symbolic); 104 short source proofs; token LM cap-6
protocol: greedy and 4-sample held-out primary (576) and structured (384) sets; 2 seeds symbolic
headline: curriculum PPO reaches 129-line proofs on 1-2/16 narrow projection challenges; token-LM RL does not improve held-out coverage (init 48/576 greedy vs 15-47 for 8 RL endpoints) and all 21 LM endpoints solve 0/384 structured

title: OLMo-32B longer-proof pilot (ICL vs SFT/DPO/RL)

protocol: 24-target greedy pilot (16 longer-reference, 8 short); 120-target and K4 evals not run; mixed-host eval

title: Proof-cap comparison 6/10/12, direct vs symbolic CoT

protocol: textbook58-dev greedy + 16 samples, SFT and final RL; one seed (20260910) per config
headline: best sampled 10/58 (Direct cap 12, from 8 after SFT); no model solves a textbook problem with reference above its own cap; long synthetic training success 0% (cap 6) -> 91.5% (cap 12) without textbook transfer

title: Proof-fragment selection and backward-reset RL curriculum
model: adapted ND model, 4 RL arms (selected/uniform x full/reset)
protocol: 768 held-out synthetic targets (256 per ref-length bin), 8 attempts; one online training seed
headline: selector predicts the supervised intervention (Spearman 0.958) but all four long-RL arms lose coverage: 269-279/768 vs 351/768 at start

title: Novelty campaign phase 1: base-model reachability of RL-found proofs
model: take-home Stage-1 (abs, random start offset) + take-home EI run
protocol: base 10^4 samples per transfer theorem (10^5 on validation-36), teacher-forced log p at T0.8; EI k=32 T0.8
headline: log p reachability calibrated (median log-ratio 0.00 on 941 theorems); base solves 934/1,638 transfer at 512 and 1,080 at 10^4; 348 of 1,411 RL-solved theorems unsolved by base at 10^4; all 29 nine-line RL proofs have base p <1e-5

title: Novelty campaign phase 2: pattern-frequency dial f in Stage-1 data
model: 30 Stage-1 models on 155k sets with pattern frequency f
train_set: 155k cap-6 sets, f in {0,1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1} for depth-3 / derived-ORE / reductio
protocol: 1,000 targets per pattern (7-12 lines, no <=6-line proof), EI 8 rounds k=32 T0.8; frozen controls; 2 seeds at f extremes
headline: depth-3 at f=0: EI acquisition 0.341/0.271 vs frozen 0 (f=0.1: 0.355/0.316); derived-ORE amplification (0.222 already at f=1e-4); reductio dial uninformative

title: Novelty campaign phase 3: textbook-shaped curriculum
model: take-home Stage-1 + EI with/without precursors
protocol: 623 textbook-schema targets, 8 EI rounds; validation-36
headline: round 8: frozen 161, EI 213, EI+precursors 222 of 623; gains confined to schemata base assigns >=1e-4 (contraposition, consequentia mirabilis, hyp. syllogism, export); De Morgan, dilemmas, Peirce stay 0-2/24

title: Novelty follow-up and ignition study (depth-3 / reductio at f=0)
model: 8 new Stage-1 seeds per set + follow-up f=0 sets
protocol: pre-RL 300 targets x 2,000; EI 8 rounds k=32; 606 derived-double-negation reductio pool; interventions from round 4
headline: reductio ignites in exactly the 4/11 draws with nonzero pre-RL rate; depth-3 at f=0 replicates (acq 0.271-0.364) and 3/5 zero-hit draws still ignite; one sibling-proof training step ignites 11/11 dead arms

title: Round 2 run 5: pattern dials on pools that require the pattern
model: novelty-campaign Stage-1 checkpoints (reductio f=0 s0-s2, f=0.1 s0-s1; cap-8 derived-ORE f=0, 1e-2)
train_set: cap-6 f sets (reductio); cap-8 sets (derived-ORE, outside cap-6 rule)
protocol: 300 required targets + transfer; EI 8 rounds k=32 T0.8; frozen 256 attempts; base pass@10^4
headline: reductio required: zero-rate draws stay 0/300, the one nonzero-rate f=0 draw reaches 51 (frozen 4), all on the 52-target 7-line stratum; strict derived-ORE f=0 EI 26/24 vs frozen 13/11 with base reaching 27/300

title: Ladder A: six EI variants vs true-length frontier L*
model: take-home cap-6 abs Stage-1 + T1-T6 EI rungs
protocol: transfer pool 2,285 (L_true 7-14 by minlen), 8x32 attempts cumulative; targets 4,495 x 256; 8 rounds T0.8; seeds 0,1
headline: transfer L*=10 for all 12 trained arms vs 7 frozen (+3 every rung); none reaches 11 in 8 rounds (counts at 10 still rising); all L_true>=9 solves have base p<1e-5 but are one implication-tower family; T6 sibling pair leads on both seeds (not established)

model: n/a (all project proof files)

headline: greedy 0.563 in Lean vs 0.258 tokens vs 0.292 English (paired Lean-tokens +0.305)

model: Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B/14B/32B instruct
protocol: 106 theorems (depth3_f0, reductio_f0, transfer9), k=16 + greedy T0.7

model: 8 new Stage-1 draws per pattern (s20-s27)

protocol: EI 8 rounds k=32 on 300 required (req) vs 300 required + 300 neighbours (mix); drift arms; transfer
headline: ignition 1/16 on req vs 9/16 on mix pools; reductio s21 shows a pattern absent at 0/600k appearing under training that never rewarded it; depth-3 neighbours were pattern-bearing, so not a clean zero-reward composition

model: run-5 checkpoints + fresh draws
train_set: cap-6 reductio f sets; cap-8 derived-ORE sets
protocol: 345 required reductio targets, 512 attempts per target (16x32 or 8x64); derived-ORE 300 required, 256 attempts, base pass@10^4
headline: 8-line reductio stratum crossed in 1/6 pre-registered 16-round arms (54 vs 1 on the same checkpoint); "zero-rate" draws are not zero-rate on 6-line targets; derived-ORE EI/base reach 0.8-2.2x, two fresh f=0 draws add 25-26 EI-only targets

protocol: 600k pre-RL samples per draw (2.0M depth-3 parts 1+2; deep passes)
headline: draws with >=1 pattern hit: depth-3 15/24, reductio 12/24, strict derived-ORE 0/24; every pre-RL pattern proof is cap+1 = 7 lines; pre-registered class separation (E2) failed
